BiblicalUsage: Shoma is a report, the fame of a man that travels ahead of him. Joshua's fame went out through all the country because the Lord was with him, the Gibeonites came from far because they had heard the fame of what God did in Egypt, and Mordecai's fame spread through all the provinces as he grew greater.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a good report is earned, not claimed, and God still spreads the fame of the faithful as He did for Joshua and Mordecai.
